messages.subject: Trouble Updating to 0.12.2
parts:
Hi, 

I'm trying to update shiny to versions 0.12.2, I currently have 0.11. However, whenever I call remove.packages("shiny") and then reinstall using install.packages("shiny"), it seems to reinstall version 0.11. I check sessionInfo() after reinstalling and calling library(shiny). I'm trying to use the new plotOutput options with ggplot2, but I can't seem to figure out the problem. I even downloaded the shiny 0.12.2 source file and tried to install it and it didn't work. I'm running R 3.0 on windows, dell PC. Is there anything else specific I have to do to update the package?

Colin

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Trouble Updating to 0.12.2
parts:
You might need to restart R before you install any packages on
Windows. Actually RStudio will automatically restart R when you click
the Update button in the Packages pane if the packages that you are
trying to install have already been loaded into R.

The other think to check is how many libraries you have, e.g.

sapply(.libPaths(), list.files)

Make sure shiny is only installed in one library. It may also be
relevant which CRAN mirror you use (when in doubt, use the RStudio
mirror :).

Regards,
Yihui
